content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Peoria

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. Review the specific hour thresholds based on your degree level. Gather documentation of your work history before applying—PMI audits credentials for quality assurance.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Bootcamp. Attend synchronous sessions on a schedule that fits your work at Caterpillar, OSF HealthCare, RLI Insurance, or elsewhere across Peoria's advanced manufacturing, healthcare, and financial services sectors. Earn your required contact hours and course completion certificate.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application and Fee
steps_items.text: Complete the official PMI credential application online, providing your education, work experience, and bootcamp completion details. Pay the required examination fee through PMI's portal. Plan for processing time before your exam authorization arrives.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources to review PMP domains and practice questions. Schedule your computer-based exam at a Pearson VUE testing center. Take the exam when you feel confident—active certified practitioners and your course instructor remain available for final review support.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) every three years to keep your PMP active. Participate in project-management training, conferences, volunteer service, or published work. Renew your credential by the PMI deadline and stay current in your field.
